english.note: Use this shortened form when the context already makes clear that the object is a ruler.

examples.english: Bring me the ruler; I need to draw a straight line.
examples.traditional: 你拎把尺過嚟，我要畫直線。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ling1 baa2 cek3 gwo3 lai4 ngo5 jiu3 waa6 zik6 sin3

english.note: Use 尺 for a physical length measurement expressed in feet or in a ruler-based context.

examples.english: The measurement of this board is six feet.
examples.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 jau5 luk6 cek3 coeng4
